scenario_name: Rental-car accident — back-ordered part, multi-party recovery
description: Maya's rental car is rear-ended on the interstate; rear bumper crushed and backup sensors damaged. No injuries. She sends photos from the roadside over WhatsApp, meeting the rental agreement's 24-hour reporting deadline.

claimant.name: Maya
claimant.why: Rich two-way media — sends damage photos/video from the roadside instantly.

repair_shop.name: Dan
repair_shop.why: Verified interactive RCS cards for estimate/appointment; auto-falls back to SMS on the lot.

lienholder.name: Priya
lienholder.why: Durable, auditable documents — coverage confirmation and settlement letter via SES.

narrative: Maya (renter) sends photos of her rear-ended rental over WhatsApp, inside the 24-hour reporting window.
Supervisor opens the claim, triages severity from the media, and fans out.
Dan (fleet coordinator) is engaged over RCS for the estimate; Priya (insurer adjuster) gets a coverage notice via SES.
Rear bumper is back-ordered 5 days -> commit gate CLOSED (parts BLOCKED).
Supervisor re-plans: arranges a swap rental for Maya, updates her proactively on WhatsApp, sources the part in 2 days.
Dan's RCS session degrades on the lot -> workflow continues on SMS with preserved state.
All required parties commit -> gate OPENS -> settlement letter (SES) to Priya + Maya notified on WhatsApp.
